# SYNESIS_E152 — Warning

## Description

REGISTRY `path` unusable.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: `REGISTRY path` is not a usable file (folder or invalid
  path). Without a registry, no IRI counts as published.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **RegistryNotFound**: `block`, `path`
